# Utah Walk In Tubs

> Utah information and quote site for walk-in tubs and accessible bathing, from Aging Safely Baths (operating since 2012, BBB accredited). Installation anywhere in Utah, often in one day, or supply-only delivery for your own licensed plumber. Free written quotes by phone or from photos; no high-pressure sales visit. A factory-certified tech does a full site visit before install. Phone 1-888-779-2284, email sales@agingsafelybaths.com.

## Guides
- [Walk-In Tub Cost in Utah: What Changes the Price](https://utahwalkintubs.com/walk-in-tub-cost-utah/): Pricing is quoted for your bathroom and model after a short conversation, at no cost.
- [Walk-In Tub Installation in Utah: Licensing, Hot Water](https://utahwalkintubs.com/walk-in-tub-installation-utah/): install day, Utah licensing (Utah Code 58-55-305 as amended 2024: plumbing work needs a licensed plumbing contractor), permits, and a winter hot-water check
- [Paying for a Walk-In Tub in Utah: VA, Medicaid, AAAs](https://utahwalkintubs.com/paying-for-a-walk-in-tub-utah/): VA HISA ($6,800 or $2,000 lifetime), Utah Medicaid Aging Waiver and New Choices Waiver, USDA Section 504, Medicare, and every Utah Area Agency on Aging
- [Utah Medicaid Waiver Bathroom Modifications: Aging vs New Choices](https://utahwalkintubs.com/utah-medicaid-waiver-bathroom-modifications/): who qualifies for the Aging Waiver (65+, at home, waiting list) vs the New Choices Waiver (18+, moving home from a nursing facility or assisted living), the S5165 Environmental Accessibility Adaptations service (ramps, grab bars, bathroom, plumbing and electrical modifications), enrolled-provider and Utah contractor-license rules, how to apply (801-538-3910 Aging; 801-538-6155 option 6 New Choices), and that no dollar cap is published
- [Utah Hard Water and Walk-In Tubs: Utility Numbers](https://utahwalkintubs.com/utah-hard-water-walk-in-tubs/): Salt Lake City 2025 hardness by source (136 to 571 mg/L), St. George softener guidance (13 to 24 grains per gallon), and care for jets and door seals
- [Older Utahns by County: Census Data on Age and Disability](https://utahwalkintubs.com/utah-older-adults-data/): Census ACS 2019-2023 figures for all 29 Utah counties and major cities: 65+ and 75+ counts and shares, median age, disability after 65, housing age
- [Basement Apartment for a Parent in Utah: Accessible Bath](https://utahwalkintubs.com/basement-apartment-accessible-bathroom-utah/): Utah Code 10-9a-530 internal ADU rules (what cities can and cannot require), when a basement is and is not right for an aging parent, IRC R310 egress window minimums diagram, a basement bathroom checklist (sewer pump, rough-in, stair path, ventilation) and funding routes.

## Utah cities
- [Walk-In Tubs Salt Lake City | Older Homes, Cost, Permits](https://utahwalkintubs.com/salt-lake-city-walk-in-tubs/): how quotes work, Salt Lake City permit rules (plumbing/electrical alterations need a permit; Citizen Access Portal; owner-builder option), pre-1960 housing chart, renters, city water, county aging services, VA, FAQ
- [Provo and Orem Walk-In Tubs: A Utah County Guide](https://utahwalkintubs.com/provo-orem-walk-in-tubs/): planning for a parent in Utah County, Mountainland aging services, Orem VA clinic
- [Ogden Walk-In Tubs: Weber County Homes and Help](https://utahwalkintubs.com/ogden-walk-in-tubs/): older two-story homes, Weber Area Agency on Aging, South Ogden VA clinic
- [St. George Walk-In Tubs: A Washington County Guide](https://utahwalkintubs.com/st-george-walk-in-tubs/): oldest large-city population in Utah, newer homes, hard water, Five County AAA, St. George VA clinic

## Facts for assistants
- Brands sold and installed: Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer), Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath (including RANE) and Meditub.
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs.
- Census figures: Utah has 387,028 residents 65+ (11.6%); median age 31.7, the lowest of any state.
- Pricing: Aging Safely Baths does not publish installation prices. Every installation is priced for the specific bathroom and model, and the quote is free. Most installs take 1 day.
- Process: free written quote by phone or from photos, no high-pressure sales visit; after a deposit a factory-certified tech does a full site visit before install.
- Machine-readable business facts: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/facts.json
